payload.title: File:Amanasaurus skeletal reconstruction.png
payload.credit_html: A new silesaurid from Carnian beds of Brazil fills a gap in the radiation of avian line archosaurs
payload.description_html: Hypothetical reconstruction of the skeleton of Amanasaurus nesbitti gen. et sp. nov. depicting (in orange) the preserved portions. (a) CAPPA/UFSM 0374 (holotype), a proximal portion of a right femur in anterior view. (b) CAPPA/UFSM 0375 (referred specimen), a distal portion of a left femur in anterior view. Figures were generated with GIMP 2.8 (https://www.gimp.org/). Cropped from original image and letters adjusted to match.
